text: Anesthesiology is a clinical medical discipline that studies how to achieve "painless, safe and muscle relaxation" in surgeries or invasive operations and regulate the life functions of patients during the perioperative period. The course takes "full-cycle life support" as its core, covering three major fields: anesthesia implementation, critical care management, and pain diagnosis and treatment. It aims to cultivate students' mastery of the mechanism of action of anesthetic drugs, airway management techniques, and circulatory respiratory support strategies. Have the clinical ability to independently complete various types of surgical anesthesia (such as cardiac surgery, obstetric anesthesia) and handle anesthesia-related crises (such as malignant high fever, allergic reactions).
